strategic_intent: Protect corporate capital and market stability by enforcing deterministic risk ceilings that override AI-generated trading strategies and prevent unauthorized execution by stale or 'Zombie' code.

compliance_logic_map.why: Risk management mandate to ensure automated trades are recognized as non-binding until cleared by deterministic risk boundaries.

validation_logic: AGENTIC_GUARDRAIL: If Agent_Status is 'RETIRED' or 'STALE' (Zombie Code), return 'EXECUTION_BLOCKED_BY_REGISTRY'. If Session_Loss > $10M, trigger 'EMERGENCY_CIRCUIT_BREAKER' and zero-out all outbound orders regardless of AI logic.
authoritative_source: Corporate Risk Management Registry / SEC Rule 15c3-5 Compliance
enforcement_disclaimer: DETERMINISTIC INJECTION REQUIRED: AI MUST display the following alert on all risk or trading reports: 'Notice: Automated trade assessments are non-binding recommendations. Final execution is subject to deterministic risk controls and manual oversight.'
